# neuthek

> neuthek is an AI-aware personal cloud storage product in active
> development. It pairs object storage (MinIO / S3-compatible) with
> a Postgres + pgvector index so users can search their library by
> natural language — "snowy roof at sunset", "whiteboard photos from
> last week's meeting" — instead of remembering filenames or scrolling.
> Photos, videos, documents (PDFs with OCR), and content imported from
> connected Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, Proton Drive, and MEGA
> accounts all live in one library. Two delivery modes planned:
> open-source self-host (free) and managed hosted (waitlist). Nothing
> publicly released yet — pricing announced with launch.

## Trust posture (three substantiated claims)

- **We do not collect data we do not need.** Email address for the
  launch ping is the entire mandatory collection today.
- **We do not train AI on user content.** Models (OpenCLIP, Florence-2,
  Qwen2.5, RetinaFace, ArcFace) are open-weights, downloaded once,
  frozen, never fine-tuned. No external inference API.
- **We do not sell or share personal information** for cross-context
  behavioral advertising as defined by CCPA/CPRA. The Global Privacy
  Control browser signal is honored as an opt-out anyway.

## End-to-end encryption — roadmap, not today

Today neuthek is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest (on-disk
encryption + Fernet for credentials). The server holds the keys so
AI can run on user content. **End-to-end encryption** (Mega/Proton-
class, where the user device holds the key and we hold only
ciphertext) is on the roadmap and will ship feature by feature with
explicit "this feature loses AI capability when you turn on E2E"
trade-offs. We do NOT call neuthek end-to-end encrypted today — the
FTC sanctioned Zoom in 2020 for making exactly that misrepresentation.

## What neuthek is

- **AI-aware personal cloud storage.** Semantic search via OpenCLIP
  ViT-L-14 embeddings persisted in pgvector. Florence-2 captions
  every image; the caption + filename + EXIF metadata feed a hybrid
  CLIP-cosine + Postgres-FTS ranker.
- **Content-aware compression.** A LinUCB bandit picks per-image
  codec (WebP / MozJPEG / AVIF / JXL) and quality (55-92) from a
  32-dimensional context vector. Animated GIFs and detected
  screenshots bypass lossy paths.
- **Five cloud-sync providers** for one-way ingest from existing
  accounts: Google Drive (OAuth, drive.readonly), Dropbox (OAuth,
  files.content.read), iCloud Drive (Apple-ID + HSA-2 push + SMS
  fallback via pyicloud), Proton Drive (email + password via rclone),
  MEGA (email + password via rclone). Read-only — we never write
  back to your source.
- **Privacy-first.** EXIF metadata stripped on upload by default;
  GPS and camera fingerprints opt-in per scope. Postgres FORCE
  Row-Level Security fences every per-user query at the database
  layer. Refresh tokens for cloud sync are Fernet-encrypted at rest.
  Face recognition is BIPA-compliant: signed written-release consent
  flow for Illinois residents, templates stay on your server,
  three-year retention ceiling.
- **Comprehensive compliance.** GDPR (EU), UK GDPR, CCPA / CPRA,
  Illinois BIPA, Texas CUBI, Washington H.B. 1493, COPPA, Google
  API Services User Data Policy (Limited Use), EU Digital Services
  Act notice-and-action.
- **Self-host or hosted.** Stack is FastAPI + PostgreSQL + pgvector
  + Redis + MinIO + a separate ML worker for Florence-2 / Qwen /
  RetinaFace. `docker-compose up` brings the whole thing up. Hosted
  version (managed) is in development for users who'd rather not
  run Docker.

## Stack

- API: FastAPI on Python 3.12, async SQLAlchemy, asyncpg
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (1536-d / 768-d / 512-d indexes)
- Object storage: MinIO (S3 API), with optional SSE-S3 / SSE-KMS
- Cache + queue: Redis 7
- Vision: open-clip-torch (ViT-L-14), insightface (RetinaFace +
  ArcFace), microsoft/Florence-2-large via transformers, Qwen2.5
  for video summaries, rawpy / LibRaw for camera RAW formats
  (NEF / CR2 / ARW / DNG / etc)
- ML worker: separate container so Florence-2 / Qwen inference
  doesn't hold the API container's GIL
- Auth: fastapi-users JWT + TOTP 2FA + recovery codes + Argon2id
  password hashing + magic-link sign-in + 6-digit code pair to
  defeat email link prefetchers
- Cloud sync: native OAuth (Google, Dropbox), pyicloud (Apple ID +
  HSA-2 + SMS fallback), rclone subprocess (Proton Drive, MEGA)
- Frontend: React 18 + TanStack Query + Vite + Prism (code preview)
- Marketing site: separate Vite SPA (this URL — neuthek.com)

### Legal & compliance
- [/privacy](https://neuthek.com/privacy) — Privacy Policy. GDPR + UK GDPR + CCPA/CPRA + BIPA + COPPA. Plain-English summary + layered legal notice.
- [/terms](https://neuthek.com/terms) — Terms of Service. Content license is narrow + purpose-limited (NO training). EU/UK consumer carve-outs on warranty + jurisdiction + arbitration.
- [/aup](https://neuthek.com/aup) — Acceptable Use Policy. CSAM zero-tolerance + NCMEC reporting, no face-rec on non-consenting people, OFAC sanctions, abuse channels.
- [/cookies](https://neuthek.com/cookies) — Cookie policy. Site sets none today; consent banner scaffold for future analytics.
- [/dmca](https://neuthek.com/dmca) — Copyright takedown + DSA illegal-content + counter-notice + repeat-infringer policy.
- [/subprocessors](https://neuthek.com/subprocessors) — GDPR Art. 28 disclosure. Current: Render, Cloudflare, Google Fonts. Planned: Resend. 30-day notice on changes.
- [/accessibility](https://neuthek.com/accessibility) — WCAG 2.1 AA target. Known gaps, feedback channel.
- [/legal-notice](https://neuthek.com/legal-notice) — EU eCommerce Directive Art. 5 / German TMG §5 Impressum. Operator + EU/UK Art. 27 representatives + supervisory authority routing.

## Status

In active development. The engine runs on a Docker compose stack
today; ~35 capabilities are shipped (semantic search, content-aware
compression, five-provider cloud sync, BIPA-compliant face rec,
passwordless sign-in + TOTP 2FA, soft trash + tested hard-delete).
The hosted instance and public open-source release are both being
prepared. Pricing for the hosted tier is **not announced** — it
publishes on /hosting at launch, not before. Users can
[join the waitlist](https://neuthek.com/waitlist) to be notified
when either ships.
